"48DNXA07.SGB", "(XB114_030)", and "2010/05/31" is silkscreened :on the back of the card (OEM: [[Wistron NeWeb]]/[[WNC]]).
This device is presumed to be identical to the [[Wistron NeWeb DNXA-H1]]. :The FCC ID of this product has been assigned to this entry. This device uses the [[Atheros]] '''XB114''' [[Atheros reference design|reference design]].
DNXA-H1 is an 802.11n dual-band 3x3 mini PCIe wifi card which delivers 450Mbps data rate. :External Rx filter provides excellent radio rejection against the interfering signal from :the 2nd Wi-Fi on con-current mode without Rx sensitivity degradation.
Mini PCIe (oversized) - 5mm longer that standard Mini PCIe Card.
